# Slider

Select a range of values on a defined interval.
See [Slider guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/slider/design/)

<Source code="import { Slider } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element

## Examples

```css
.w-480 { width: 480px; }
```

### Dark Mode

<Canvas of={SliderStories.Dark} />


Details about implementing dark mode is available in <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Introduction" story="docs">Visual styles Page</LinkTo>

### With ticks

Combine `min`, `max`, `step` and `ticks` props to display custom ranges.

<Canvas of={SliderStories.Ticks} />


### Min distance

By default the min distance between thumbs is the `step` value.
Use the `minDistance` prop to customize this distance, or allow thumbs to cross by setting the value to `0`.

<Canvas of={SliderStories.MinDistance} />


### Labelling

Use a <LinkTo kind="Components/FormControl" story="Basic">Form Control</LinkTo> component to display a label.
You can also customize the thumbs and ticks labels.

<Canvas of={SliderStories.Labelling} />
